request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Recolour only his yellow-olive skin (face, ears, arms, hands) to a fresh bright leaf green, not olive and not yellow: colour #5aa546, with light green #98d975 on the face, nose and cheeks and #3f8232 only as thin shading. Keep everything else exactly the same: the open shouting mouth, tusks, eyes, beard, horned tin helmet, cream fur mantle, yellow megaphone, straps, kilt, boots, pose, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
